"""Exact value-profile book publication, unchanged capacity and native rendered guidance."""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, need, pin, save

CHAPTER = Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
REGISTRY = Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
ANCHOR = 'The complete finite raw-address and numerical/source parent acceptance is now\nqualified.'
ADDITION = '''Complete remaining scalar and value-profile qualification now joins every original
source-value and profile-boundary obligation. A separate source traversal
reconstructs complete operands, schemas, ordered roles, known values, constructor
qualifications and phase allocations. Guard-derived scalar forms remain distinct
from declared logical fields; entire inherited inner operands retain their dated
evidence role.

Each original reference, receiver, private framework interval and eval boundary
keeps its explicit unmeasured meaning. Complete original records and public
boundary products retain every captured byte as evidence. Their tokens do not
supply a new source-constructor oracle. Original formatter settings, native
flags, encoding and identities remain unmeasured. The source do operation and
the diagnostic require marker keep separate roles throughout the join.

Every prerequisite executes again in its proper context. Source readers use
current fixed source inputs; the dated publication reader uses all inputs from
its exact committed epoch in a repository-local checkpoint. Its rejection of
later task metadata remains a rejection. The fresh checkpoint execution and
complete before/after byte conservation qualify the dated result separately.

Whole omitted, borrowed, reordered, wrong-role, schema, value, encoding, profile,
private-meaning and acceptance controls reject. Replay the complete qualification:

```sh
scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/observer-value-profile-boundaries-20261010/verify.py
```

This completes only the remaining-value parent and its boundary child. Complete
source-value parent acceptance, source-generated original headers, the original
body join and observer publication retain their separate owners. Higher raw,
native/private and visual scopes remain open.

'''


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*args],capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,'whole fixed book authority')
    return result.stdout


def aggregate(rows):
    return dict(files=len(rows),lines_total=sum(r.count(b'\n') for r in rows),bytes_total=sum(map(len,rows)))


def source():
    names = sorted(name for name in git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
                   if Path(name).parent == Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md'))
    before = {name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names}
    need(before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().count(ANCHOR)==1 and ADDITION not in before[str(CHAPTER)].decode(), 'unique value-profile guide source seam')
    after=dict(before)
    after[str(CHAPTER)]=before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().replace(ANCHOR,ADDITION+ANCHOR,1).encode()
    return before,after


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--publish',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native-output',default='book-native.json',choices=['book-native.json','book-native-final.json'])
    args=parser.parse_args()
    before,after=source()
    current={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}
    if args.publish:
        need(current==before, 'publish only the owned sole value-profile book addition')
        CHAPTER.write_bytes(after[str(CHAPTER)])
        rows=[json.loads(line) for line in REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()]
        authority=next(r for r in rows if r.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')['reference_contract']
        a,b=aggregate(list(before.values())),aggregate(list(after.values()))
        authority['aggregate_change']=dict(authority_id='OBSERVER-VALUE-PROFILE-BOUNDARIES-20261010',
            owner=(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0],baseline=a,
            delta={key:b[key]-a[key] for key in a},
            rationale='Document complete remaining-value obligation and opaque-profile qualification while preserving whole inherited evidence and all original native/settings/private and higher header/raw boundaries.')
        REGISTRY.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for r in rows))
        save('book-publication.json',dict(revision=REVISION,addition=ADDITION,
            before={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()}, after={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},
            authority=authority['aggregate_change']))
        print('PASS exact sole value-profile book addition and fresh aggregate authority; capacity ceilings unchanged.')
    else:
        need(current==after, 'entire current value-profile book publication and complete unchanged peers')
        if args.native:
            class Text(HTMLParser):
                def __init__(self):
                    super().__init__();self.parts=[]
                def handle_data(self,data):
                    self.parts.append(data)
            raw=Path('docs/book/book/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.html').read_bytes()
            reader=Text();reader.feed(raw.decode())
            rendered=ADDITION
            expected=' '.join(line for line in rendered.splitlines() if not line.startswith('```'))
            need(' '.join(''.join(reader.parts).split()).count(' '.join(expected.split()))==1,
                 'whole unique rendered value-profile guide')
            save(args.native_output,dict(chapter=pin(raw),addition=pin(ADDITION.encode()),
                scope='Whole native guidance text and source custody only; visual book QA remains open.'))
        print('PASS complete current value-profile guide and source publication; visual QA remains separately owned.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import sys

from common import BASE,REGEX,REPAIR,REVISION,SCOPE,load,need,pin,same,save

ROOT=Path('.artifacts/observer-value-profile-boundaries-20261010/publication-checkpoint')
PREFIXES=['docs/tasks',str(REGEX),str(REPAIR),'docs/TASK_TREE.md','doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl']


def main():
    need(sys.argv[1:] in ([],['--replay']),'explicit initial capture versus fresh fixed-context replay')
    replay=bool(sys.argv[1:])
    listing=['git','--no-replace-objects','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--',*PREFIXES]
    result=subprocess.run(listing,capture_output=True,text=True)
    need(result.returncode==0 and result.stderr=='','whole fixed dated-publication input membership')
    names=result.stdout.splitlines()
    need(names and len(names)==len(set(names)),'complete distinct fixed checkpoint members')
    need(replay or not ROOT.exists(),'retain complete first checkpoint workspace')
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=replay)
    members={}
    for name in names:
        path=Path(name)
        need(not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts,'repository-relative checkpoint member')
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+name]
        source=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(source.returncode==0 and source.stderr==b'','whole fixed checkpoint byte retrieval')
        target=ROOT/path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        if target.exists():
            need(replay and target.read_bytes()==source.stdout,'whole existing checkpoint member matches fixed source')
        else:
            target.write_bytes(source.stdout)
        members[name]=dict(identity=pin(source.stdout),command=command,status=source.returncode)
    before={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    need(before=={name:row['identity'] for name,row in members.items()},'whole copied checkpoint matches fixed Git inputs')
    command=['python3','-B',str(REPAIR/'verify.py')]

    after={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    record=dict(revision=REVISION,cwd=str(ROOT),members=members,listing=dict(command=listing,status=result.returncode,
        stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr),command=command,status=actual.returncode,stdout=actual.stdout,
        stderr=actual.stderr,before=before,after=after,scope=SCOPE,
        meaning='Actual fresh execution against whole immutable committed inputs; no current mutable task state or borrowed result is admitted as the dated publication epoch.')
    if replay:
        need(same(record,load('checkpoint-publication.json')),'whole actual fresh fixed-context result and input conservation')
    else:
        save('checkpoint-publication.json',record)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr=='' and actual.stdout.startswith('PASS '),
         'actual fresh dated publication checkpoint success')
    need(before==after,'dated reader conserves every complete checkpoint input and creates no artifact')
    print('PASS fresh complete dated-publication checkpoint execution, fixed Git byte custody and before/after input conservation; no original native scope is promoted.')

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/observer-value-profile-boundaries-20261010/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

from common import BASE,CENSUS,PREDICATE,SCALAR,REGEX,SCOPE,canonical,load,need,pin,read,save


def key(path):
    return tuple(path)


def source_product(source,census,predicate,scalar,regex,regex_plan):
    predicates={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(predicate['rows'])}
    scalars={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(scalar['members'])}
    regexes={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(regex['members'])}
    authored={r['helper']:r for r in regex['authored']}
    operands=[]
    for row in census['operands']:
        path,operand,schema=row['path'],row['input'],row['schema']
        if key(path) in predicates:
            index=predicates[key(path)]; value=predicate['rows'][index]
            need(value['input']==operand,'complete original predicate/source operand join')
            qualification=dict(kind='qualified whole guard construction',source_row=index,
                source_row_identity=pin(canonical(value)),defined=value['defined'],string_value=value['string_value'],
                numeric_value=value['numeric_value'],source_expression=value['source_expression'],
                original_native_scalar_flags=value['original_native_scalar_flags'],
                meaning='Source guard determines the value; a declared logical zero field is not an encoded-token oracle.')
        elif schema in ('scalar','context_scalar'):
            index=scalars[key(path)]; member=scalar['members'][index]
            need(member['operand']==operand and member['schema']==schema,'whole scalar member/source/schema join')
            value=scalar['values'][member['value']]
            qualification=dict(kind='qualified complete scalar value',source_member=index,
                value_id=member['value'],value=value['value'],constructor=value['constructor'],
                evidence_role=member['evidence_role'],original_native_scalar_flags='not measured')
        elif schema=='regex_source':
            index=regexes[key(path)]; member=regex['members'][index]
            need(member['operand']==operand,'whole regex member/source role join')
            recipe=authored[member['helper']]
            qualification=dict(kind='qualified whole authored regex',source_member=index,helper=member['helper'],
                authored=recipe,current_cases=[r for r in regex_plan['cases'] if r['body']==recipe['body']],
                original_native_flags_encoding='not measured',original_regexp_provider_identity='not measured')
        else:
            need(schema in ('reference','context_reference'),'closed remaining reference boundary schema')
            qualification=dict(kind='source reference role and kind only',reference_kind=operand['reference_kind'],
                original_address_identity_flags_referent='not measured',current_fixture_borrowing='forbidden')
        operands.append(dict(path=path,schema=schema,input=operand,qualification=qualification))
    phases=[]
    for m,mode in enumerate(source['modes']):
        for c,case in enumerate(mode['cases']):
            for p,phase in enumerate(case['phases']):
                public=phase['public']
                need(public['historical_profile']=='unmeasured' and public['source_operator']=='do',
                     'whole original profile and source do boundary')
                need(public['load']=='require ./t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t'
                     and phase['own']['load']==public['load'],'source do versus whole diagnostic require marker')
                phases.append(dict(path=['modes',m,'cases',c,'phases',p],mode=mode['mode'],domain=case['domain'],
                    index=case['index'],phase=p,source_public=public,source_phase={k:v for k,v in phase.items() if k not in ('own','public')},
                    original_settings_formatter='unmeasured',receiver_contents_class_identity='unmeasured',
                    private_framework_eval_meaning='unmeasured',diagnostic_marker_changes_source_operator=False))
    operand_positions={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(operands)}
    phase_positions={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(phases)}
    obligations={}
    for name,paths in census['obligations'].items():
        obligations[name]=[dict(path=path,resolution_kind='operand' if key(path) in operand_positions else 'phase',
            resolution_index=(operand_positions if key(path) in operand_positions else phase_positions)[key(path)]) for path in paths]
    return dict(scope=SCOPE,operands=operands,phases=phases,obligations=obligations,loads=census['loads'],
        source_scope=source['scope'],historical_scope=source['frame_model']['historical'],
        predicate_public_profile=predicate['current_profile'],predicate_original_settings=predicate['original_observer_settings'],
        regex_public_profile=regex_plan['profile'],
        dependencies={str(path):pin(path.read_bytes()) for path in [CENSUS/'source-models.json',CENSUS/'census.json',
            PREDICATE/'predicate-values-qualified.json',SCALAR/'scalars.json',REGEX/'regexes.json',REGEX/'plan.json']})


def main():

        read(PREDICATE/'predicate-values-qualified.json'),read(SCALAR/'scalars.json'),read(REGEX/'regexes.json'),read(REGEX/'plan.json'))

        product=pin(canonical(product)),programs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}))

"""Attach complete dated original evidence without borrowing semantic values."""
from common import BASE,PUBLIC,RAW,SCOPE,canonical,load,need,pin,read,save


def derive(product,public,raw):
    public_cases={(mode['mode'],case['domain'],case['index']):case
        for mode in public['observations']['modes'] for case in mode['cases']}
    records={(mode['mode'],domain,row['index']):row for mode in raw['inventories']
        for domain,rows in mode['domains'].items() for row in rows['nonempty']}
    bodies={};phases=[]
    for source in product['phases']:
        key=(source['mode'],source['domain'],source['index'])
        case,record=public_cases[key],records[key]
        need(case['original_body']==record['body_identity']==pin(record['body'].encode()),
             'whole inherited original body custody at source boundary')
        identifier=pin(canonical(list(key)))['sha256']
        bodies[identifier]=dict(key=list(key),record=record,
            meaning='Whole inherited original body/record custody only; no new semantic header, identity or private-meaning oracle.')
        phase=case['phases'][source['phase']]
        need(phase['phase']==source['phase'] and phase['source_operator']=='do',
             'whole original public phase and source loading role')
        phases.append(dict(path=source['path'],body=identifier,original_public_boundary=phase,
            original_public_case={k:v for k,v in case.items() if k!='phases'},
            meaning='Every original receiver token, private framework/eval interval and full raw body retains as dated opaque evidence; native identity/settings/private semantics remain unmeasured.'))
    return dict(scope=SCOPE,phases=phases,original_records=bodies,
        inputs={str(path):pin(path.read_bytes()) for path in (PUBLIC,RAW)},
        public_scope=public['observations']['scope'],raw_scope=raw['scope'])


def main():
    need((BASE/'source-products.json').exists() and (BASE/'source-selection.json').exists(),
         'whole source hypotheses precede own opaque attachment')
    save('opaque-evidence.json',derive(load('source-products.json'),read(PUBLIC),read(RAW)))
    print('PASS whole dated original records, public receiver/private boundaries and source allocation retained only as opaque evidence.')

"""Conserve every prior surface and ceiling around the exact value-profile publication."""

def declaration(original,task):
    expected=json.loads(json.dumps(original))
    for dimension,actual in task['task'].items():
        need(type(actual) is int and actual>0,'typed complete task measurement')
        allowance=expected['baseline'][dimension]+expected['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]
        if actual>allowance:
            expected['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]=min(actual+expected['transition']['ratchet_step'][dimension],
                expected['enforcement_ceilings'][dimension])-expected['baseline'][dimension]
        need(actual<=expected['baseline'][dimension]+expected['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]
             <=expected['enforcement_ceilings'][dimension],'exact measured task growth inside unchanged ceiling')
    need(same(expected,task['task_declaration']),'entire exact measured task declaration')
    return expected


def main():
    need(sys.argv[1:] in ([],['--current']),'explicit dated versus current publication')
    before=[json.loads(line) for line in book.git('show',REVISION+':'+str(book.REGISTRY)).splitlines()]
    after=json.loads(json.dumps(before))
    report=load('book-publication.json')
    source_before,source_after=book.source()
    need(report['revision']==REVISION and report['addition']==book.ADDITION
         and report['before']=={k:pin(v) for k,v in source_before.items()}
         and report['after']=={k:pin(v) for k,v in source_after.items()},'entire sole owned book source change')
    a,b=book.aggregate(list(source_before.values())),book.aggregate(list(source_after.values()))

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])

        need(not same([p,e,c],[product,evidence,contracts]),'genuine complete value/profile hostile candidate')

    operands='whole independent source/profile field: operands'

        ['original_public_boundary']['remaining_framework'].pop(),'whole independent original opaque field: phases')
